D015-D007_h001.question:
It’s been over a year now, this feeling. Just… heavy. Like I'm wading through thick mud every single day. Getting myself to the toll booth feels like climbing a mountain. Honestly, sometimes I think about just driving my car into the barrier, or just letting go of the wheel on my way home. It feels like a plan, sometimes.

And then there are the voices. They whisper things, sometimes nice, sometimes not. They tell me I’m special, that I have a gift, and that I'm destined for something great, more than just this booth. Nobody else seems to hear them, though. It’s strange, because sometimes I hear them even when I don't feel quite so down, but it's mostly when the dark cloud is really heavy. It just adds to the confusion.

    B. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    C. Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
    D. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features

D015-D007_h002.question:
